about: The Preface of the Epiphany of the Lord. It praises the Only-begotten Son, Who appeared in our mortal nature and renewed us by the light of His immortality.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: Truly it is right and just, fitting and leading to salvation, that we should give You thanks always and everywhere:
O Lord, holy Father, almighty eternal God:
For when Your only-begotten Son appeared in the substance of our mortality, He renewed us by the new light of His immortality.

a.g: He renewed us by the new light of His immortality

seg.tr: And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominions, and with all the host of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of Your glory, evermore saying:
